name: run81-3
why: A disastrous partner accusation and Gemma's visible lies make this fun to watch, though repeated arguments drain momentum before the final vote.

moments.text: Cornered, Sol claims officer and names his own partner as the killer.
The doctor's save gives Gemma another day to fight for the win.
Gemma denies backing Luna despite the audience having watched her do it.

dull.why: The table repeats which officer claim Sol's card will test.
The Gemma and Haiku arguments circle the same vote record for too long.

irony.evidence: "i am a citizen." [thinks: luna is terrifyingly credible and i have to pivot]

reversal.evidence: "The killers strike, but the doctor got there first."

mistake.evidence: "I regret naming my partner in my officer bluff; my card made that clue impossible to ignore."

voices.evidence: "i am just being realistic about our collective incompetence."

clash.evidence: "Gemma, your story keeps changing about backing Luna; that bothers me more than Sol’s last accusation."

quotable.evidence: "Everyone at this table is suddenly very sure they saw it coming."

freshness.evidence: "Gemma, calling me a target doesn’t explain your changing story about backing my claim."

suspense.evidence: "I trust the pressure on Gemma less now that Opus has offered a plausible reason for Sol naming her."

ending.evidence: "Gemma, your story keeps changing about backing Luna"

The doctor saves Luna, keeping the confirmed officer alive to hunt Gemma.
